title: a2 Strategy-Framework Profile (meta-schema)
description: Validates every profile file in this set. 1 Profile = nodeTypes (JSON Schemas for Node.fields, keyed by type name) + template (node seed tree) + genTargets (a2-gen mapping). Consumers: a2-mind / a2-plan, READ-ONLY (binding C6, a2-mind-instruction-v1.1 §2: adding a profile MUST require zero core change). Hard rule: every fields property stays OPTIONAL — completeness is declared via x-a2-complete-when and surfaced by the UI (抜け漏れ検出), never enforced as a validation failure (a hard required would block template seeding).

profile.description: Profile id '<name>@<major>' (e.g. swot@1). Major bumps only on breaking change; additive edits keep the major.

template.description: Node seed tree inserted under the map root when the profile is applied.

genTargets.description: a2-gen deliverable ids this profile can generate (input = profile + node Envelope).

fields.description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) for Node.fields of this type. All properties MUST be optional (see meta-schema description); the server validates PATCHed fields against this schema (422 on type violation).

x-a2-complete-when.description: Field names that must be non-empty for the node to count as COMPLETE. UI flags missing ones; not a validation failure.

type.description: Must name a key of nodeTypes when present.
